Fortified.MissileSizeClassDef.label: loitering munitions
Fortified.MissileSizeClassDef.description: Loitering munition: the earliest beyond-visual-range weapon. Tilt-launched and allowed on gravships. It is slow, but its small radar signature means it is detected later.

Fortified.MissileSizeClassDef.label: light missiles
Fortified.MissileSizeClassDef.description: Light missile: short- to medium-range air defense or ground attack, loaded into multi-round launchers.

Fortified.MissileSizeClassDef.label: medium missiles
Fortified.MissileSizeClassDef.description: Medium missile: cruise or anti-ballistic missions. Parts can be customized on the item or on a storage rack.

Fortified.MissileSizeClassDef.label: ballistic missiles
Fortified.MissileSizeClassDef.description: Ballistic missile: long-range strike. Vertical launch only and cannot be built on a gravship. It is built and configured directly on the launch silo.

Fortified.CombatDomainDef.label: air
Fortified.CombatDomainDef.description: Aircraft, missiles, drop pods and interceptors.
